description: Discover audience needs and relevant prompts, then use competitor insights to develop more useful, distinctive and competitive content.

defaultPrompt: Find prompts for a future topic or existing URL
Run a gap analysis and compare my content with competitors
interface.longDescription:
Understand your audience’s needs and the questions they may ask AI systems. Discover relevant prompts, compare competing content, and turn those insights into more useful, distinctive and competitive content.

AI Prompt Research: Explore relevant questions for a future topic or existing URL. Identify opportunities to create content that could serve as a useful source for AI-generated answers, then plan comprehensive responses as FAQs or articles.

SEO & GEO Content Gap Analysis: Compare your page or text with competitor content to identify missing topics, shallow coverage and relevant terms. Prioritize improvements around your readers’ needs while preserving your expertise, original evidence and distinctive perspective. Competitor-only analysis is also supported.

When a URL is supplied and access permits, inspect accessible main content and structured data, including markup in the page source. Report validation findings and limitations, and recommend markup suited to the content. Cookie notices, navigation and repeated header or footer boilerplate are excluded from the editorial comparison; relevant structured data remains in scope wherever it appears.

Supports multilingual research and adapts results to the user’s language, explicit requirements or the language of the supplied topic or page.

For beginners: this plugin provides instructional skills for initial research and content planning. It has no dedicated professional search-engine or AI-platform data connections and no dedicated crawler. Page retrieval and structured-data checks depend on the tools available in the host; complete, reliable crawling is not guaranteed. Findings provide qualitative guidance, not measured search demand, rankings or citation rates. The plugin does not replace professional data, a technical audit or editorial judgment.

publication.release_notes: Refines the listing subtitle and description to clarify the audience-needs mission, content analysis scope, structured-data checks and beginner limitations.
